`mini.tar.bz2` mirrors a Library of Congress OCR batch bundle (`<lccn>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/ed-<n>/seq-<n>/ocr.txt|ocr.xml`).
Real pages from batch `fu_three_ver02` (Gainesville Daily Sun, sn95026977, July 1–2, 1909), public domain.
`sn95026977/1932/03/04/ed-1/seq-1/ocr.txt` is SYNTHETIC: a copy of the 1909-07-02 page placed under a 1932 path, to test that 1931+ pages are skipped.
